The "'''Imperial Ace'''" was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Ace participated in the [[Battle of Mygeeto (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Mygeeto]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to regain control of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Ace played a vital part in the Empire's victory, defending the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] from Rebel attack and providing aerial support for Imperial [[Imperial Army/Legends|ground forces]]. His actions brought him to the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who selected the Ace to fly [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|his personal]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] on a mission to destroy the [[Rebel outpost (Mygeeto)|Rebel outpost's]] main [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]].

==Biography==
===The battle of Mygeeto===
====Preparing for battle====
This individual who lived during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as a [[TIE pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was considered an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]<ref name="IA" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

In 3 ABY,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] had established an [[Rebel outpost (Mygeeto)|outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]],<ref name="IA" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world with an almost entirely [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] crust which had previously served as an Imperial currency reserve.<ref name="TEA" /> In order to regain control of Mygeeto, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fleet on an [[Battle of Mygeeto (Galactic Civil War)|invasion]] of the planet. To ensure that the operation went smoothly, Vader transferred elite pilots from throughout the Empire to his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], including the Imperial Ace.<ref name="IA" />

When the fleet reached Mygeeto, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], commander of the ''Executor'', ordered the Imperial Ace's [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to conduct a reconnaissance mission in orbit of the planet. The Ace's scouting mission soon ran into Rebel starfighters but the Imperials' [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] proved a match for the Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. After eliminating the opposition, the Imperials returned to the ''Executor'' where analysis of the Ace's reconnaissance data revealed to Admiral Piett that the Rebels were aware of the Imperial fleet's presence.<ref name="IA" />

====Rebel counterattack====
[[File:Piett_briefing_IA.png|thumb|left|240px|The Ace is briefed by Admiral Firmus Piett.]]
Piett expected the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] to mount a counterattack and, upon discovery of Rebel scouts in the nearby [[Zuborte Ma|Mygeeto asteroid field]], dispatched the Ace to prevent them from learning more of the Imperial strength. Maneuvering through the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]], the Ace prevented the escape of numerous X-wings and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] carrying information on the Imperial fleet before returning to the ''Executor''.<ref name="IA" />

As expected, the Rebel fleet soon arrived and engaged the Imperial forces, causing Piett to order the Ace to join in the defense of the armada. Flying a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]], the Ace played a vital role in the battle, fighting through the numerous fighters and using his [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] to assist in the destruction of several enemy [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] and [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]. The Ace's performance in the battle led Piett to personally recommend him to Darth Vader.<ref name="IA" />

====Ground assault====
[[File:Vader_IA.png|thumb|right|240px|Darth Vader briefs the Ace.]]
Imperial [[Imperial Army/Legends|ground forces]] had were preparing to land on the planet's surface and the Dark Lord of the Sith gave the Ace a special assignment to provide aerial support for the operation. In a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], the Ace negotiated the planet's canyons and engaged enemy ground forces, including [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]], before making [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] runs on the Rebel's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. The Ace's success left Vader confident that the Rebels would soon surrender.<ref name="IA" />

While Vader personally commanded the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] attack on the Rebel headquarters, he supplied the Ace with [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|his personal]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] for another special mission&mdash;to destroy the Rebel base's main [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] before the ground forces moved in. Returning to the surface, the Ace fought through enemy Y-wings and used his concussion missiles to eliminate the power generator. With the generator destroyed, the Imperial ground forces quickly overwhelmed the remaining Rebel forces.<ref name="IA" />

After the battle, the Ace was highly decorated for his role in the Imperial victory. Darth Vader also sensed that the pilot demonstrated some [[Force-sensitive/Legends|potential]] with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Dark Lord of the Sith continued to follow his career closely.<ref name="IA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Ace was created as the player character for the [[2006]] mobile phone [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Ace]]'', which was developed by [[Fishlabs Entertainment]] GmbH and released in Europe.<ref name="cover" /><ref name="IA" /><ref name="blog">{{Blog|danwallace|145|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 3 of 5)}}</ref> The Ace only appears in the flight suit of a TIE pilot and, as such, the character's appearance is unknown. The character's name is also not identified in the game. Though the Ace's pronouns are not specified in the game,<ref name="IA" /> [[:File:Ace cover.jpg|promotional material]] states "As a TIE fighter ace pilot the player receives his orders from Admiral Piett and Darth Vader himself."<ref name="cover" />
